workLog.action: Rewrote the Copilot body translator to inline-translate invocations instead of appending a reference table
workLog.result: Deleted _build_invocation_appendix, _SKILL_CALL_RE, and _TASK_CALL_RE from build/scripts/copilot_body_translation.py. Added _find_matching_paren (quote-aware balanced-paren scan), _render_invocation, and _translate_invocations (whole-body scan including fenced code, absorbs wrapping backticks). translate_body now runs includes then arguments then invocations, with no appendix. Skill(skill="X") renders as a backticked skill: "X" span; Task(subagent_type="Y") as agent_type: "<plugin>:Y"; a prompt="Z" argument appends with prompt "Z". Chosen because the bare backticked span reads correctly at every call site, including orphan-ref-validator's meta-line The `Skill(...)` invocation form which any leading-article form would turn into The the.
